recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add unknown to MedicationStatement.status unless Pharmacy reopens the current MedicationStatement status/adherence model; future work should start from FHIR-32060, FHIR-32858, and FHIR-39271 rather than the superseded DSTU2 status model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive Pharmacy change request for DSTU2 asking to add unknown to the MedicationStatement.status value set so MedicationStatements derived from MedicationRequests with unknown status could also report status unknown.
initial_application: Historical commit 4b21106775caa782aa07057cdc51cb67b83f467f, cited in the Jira comment, added unknown to the then-active MedicationStatement status spreadsheet, updated the status short display, and updated notes for the unknown/taken scenario.
additional_context: Later Published Pharmacy decisions superseded the old status-code model: FHIR-19468 and FHIR-19470 added adherence for taking/not-taking semantics, FHIR-28593 made status a record-status element, FHIR-32060 removed unknown from record status and added draft, FHIR-32858 confirmed medication-use scenarios are represented with effective[x] and adherence, and FHIR-39271 confirmed the same model after the resource name returned to MedicationStatement. Those related issues are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The latest combined-branch source actively includes MedicationStatement, defines MedicationStatement.status as recorded | entered-in-error | draft with record-status wording, and has no unknown code in the required status CodeSystem. The adherence CodeSystem includes unknown for whether the medication is being taken.

related_jiras.note: Removed not-taken from MedicationStatement/MedicationUsage status and added adherence for taking/not-taking semantics.
Added MedicationUsage.adherence with an unknown value for unable-to-obtain medication taking/adherence information.
Narrowed status to record-status semantics rather than medication-use clinical status.
Explicitly removed unknown from record status, renamed completed to recorded, and added draft.
Confirmed medication-use scenarios are represented with effective[x], adherence.code, and adherence.reason instead of restoring old status codes.
Confirmed after the rename back to MedicationStatement that status is statement record status and adherence carries taking/not-taking meaning.

evidence_items.learned: This establishes the seed request and original status-code target.

evidence_items.summary: Historical commit added unknown to the old MedicationStatement status spreadsheet and updated MedicationStatement notes.
evidence_items.learned: The seed had a substantive historical source application before later status redesigns.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationStatement is active, and MedicationStatement.status is recorded | entered-in-error | draft with text limiting status to recording the statement and pointing medication-use semantics to adherence.
evidence_items.learned: The current build-scope StructureDefinition intentionally no longer uses status for the DSTU2 medication-use meaning.

evidence_items.summary: The active MedicationStatement status CodeSystem contains recorded, entered-in-error, and draft, and the ValueSet includes that CodeSystem.
evidence_items.learned: Unknown is intentionally absent from the current required status terminology.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationStatement.adherence.code is bound to the adherence value set, whose code system includes unknown for whether the medication is being taken.
evidence_items.learned: The current model carries medication-taking uncertainty through adherence rather than status.

evidence_items.summary: Later Published Pharmacy decisions narrowed status to record status, removed unknown from status, added draft, and assigned medication taking/not-taking semantics to adherence/effective[x].
evidence_items.learned: These later decisions supersede the original FHIR-13081 status-value request for the current build.

evidence_items.learned: Community discussion supports the Jira chronology that led to removing unknown from status.

evidence_items.learned: Meeting evidence aligns with the Jira transition from old medication-use statuses to adherence plus record status.
